profile.headline: Power Platform Developer at Peraton
profile.summary: Experienced Power Platform Developer who has designed and enhanced various government customer SharePoint sites using PowerApps, Power BI and Power Automate. Also experienced in standard front end development tools using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Focused on the execution and implementation of standard software architecture patterns while meeting the timelines set forth by project leaders.

positions.title: Power Platform Developer/Software Developer
positions.description:
Support federal contract by maintaining data within SharePoint and Dataverse datasets, displaying said data on dashboards via Microsoft PowerBI, and developing a graphic user interface for fed employees to input data using PowerApps. Created components and custom UI pages using both Canvas and Model Driven applications for government client using both SharePoint and Dataverse. Created PowerApps application for storing and tracking the project's hardware and software inventory. Created Power BI dashboards to display inventory as well as risk/issue management for team members. Received platinum and gold awards for these contributions to the project. Received Microsoft PL-900 Certification.

Technical experience including but not limited to:
- Power Apps
- Power BI
- Power Automate 
- Dataverse
- SharePoint
- OneNote
- Planner
- Outlook

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Supporting government SharePoint sites using tools such as Power BI and PowerApps to fully enhance SharePoint sites style and functionality. Proficient in Microsoft's Power Platform. Received CompTIA Sec+ certification.

Technical experience including but not limited to:
- Power Apps
- Power BI
- Power Automate 
- SharePoint Online
- SharePoint 2013
- VBA coding in Excel
- SPFX Frameworks
- JIRA
- JSON

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: HTML · Mobile Application Design · Sprint Planning · Agile Methodologies · Database Management System (DBMS) · JSON · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Supported government applications using Angular 6 for the front-end and Java for the backend of applications. Ran backend in Eclipse and front-end in Visual Studio Code to display applications. Used Microsoft Server Management Studio 17 to retrieve data for the application. Lead daily meetings if the Project Manager was not available to do so. 

Technical experience included but not limited to:
-Agile development environment
-Git branching and Git Bucket via SourceTree
-HTML, CSS, JavaScript
-Tortoise SVN
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Automation · Sprint Planning · Microsoft SQL Server · Agile Methodologies · Database Management System (DBMS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Web Developer (Level I)
positions.description:
Supported government applications using Angular 6 for the front-end side of applications. Used both Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code to run and display these applications. Contributed ideas to the development team on the best “courses of action” for each application. Worked in MySQL for the database-side of applications.

Technical experience included but not limited to:
-Supported Scrum development environment
-Git and GitHub to make changes to applications
-Jira to log work completed
-Effectively used Linux commands to create edit or remove files
-Node js, React, and ran installations on Linux
-Familiarity with Ansible and Postgres installation for running playbooks
